```yamlfile
name: CI CMake

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    name: linux-gcc-ubsan-ootree
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup apt cache (Linux)
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: /var/cache/apt
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-apt-cache-ubuntu-latest-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-apt-cache-ubuntu-latest-
            ${{ runner.os }}-apt-cache-

      - name: Setup Common Prerequisites
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install gcc-multilib g++-multilib
          sudo apt install valgrind

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: 3.x
          architecture: x64

      - name: Install Python Dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install docutils pygments

      - name: Check Available Configure Presets
        run: cmake --list-presets

      - name: Fast Configure
        run: cmake --preset=linux-gcc-ubsan-ootree-fast -DPython3_ROOT_DIR="${{ env.pythonLocation }}"

      - name: Fast Build
        run: cmake --build --preset=linux-gcc-ubsan-ootree-fast -j$(nproc)

      - name: Install
        run: cmake --build --preset=linux-gcc-ubsan-ootree-fast --target install

      - name: Minimal Install Test
        working-directory: ./install/bin
        run: ./re2c --version

      - name: Get build dir
        id: build-info
        run: |
          BUILD_DIR="${{ github.workspace }}/.build/linux-gcc-ubsan-ootree-full"
          echo "BUILD_DIR=$BUILD_DIR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Full Configure
        run: cmake --preset=linux-gcc-ubsan-ootree-full -DPython3_ROOT_DIR="${{ env.pythonLocation }}"

      - name: Full Build
        run: |
          find src -name '*.re' | xargs touch
          cmake --build --preset=linux-gcc-ubsan-ootree-full -j$(nproc)

      - name: Run Main Test Suite
        run: bash -c "ulimit -s 256; cmake --build --preset=linux-gcc-ubsan-ootree-full --target tests -j$(nproc)"

      - name: Archive test artifacts
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: test-linux-gcc-ubsan-ootree
          path: |
            test_[0-9]*
            ${{ steps.build-info.outputs.BUILD_DIR }}/test_[0-9]*
          retention-days: 30
```
